title: Email provider settings
description: One email provider's connection settings, with provenance. Every value must be traceable to the provider's own documentation listed in `sources`.

domains.description: The address domains people type. May be empty for a provider used only on customers' own domains (GoDaddy, Microsoft 365); such a provider is resolved by mx_patterns instead.

settings_unverified.description: True when first-party server settings could not be confirmed. Retained values are historical and must not be used to generate autoconfig files.

client_access.description: False when the provider offers no IMAP or SMTP at all.

auth_methods.description: Documented client authentication methods; null means unknown or not applicable. The authentication text and cited first-party sources remain the evidence.

undocumented.description: Field names the provider publishes a server for but never specifies.

sources.description: The provider's own page(s) each value was read from.

verified.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) the values were last checked against `sources`.

security.description: null means the provider does not state it; pair with an entry in `undocumented`.

security_documented.description: False when the provider publishes the server but never states its encryption.
